newsitem.title: USA: RG&E is possible victim of illegal bidding.
newsitem.headline: RG&E is possible victim of illegal bidding.

text.p: Rochester Gas & Electric said it is an apparent victim of alleged illegal action by a contractor who bid for utility installation work.
The company said it is continuing to cooperate fully with the U.S. Department of Justice.

"While RG&E and its employees are not involved, we are concerned by the possibility, as the government alleges, that at least one contractor engaged in unlawful activity in connection with bidding for our work," it said in a statement.

"RG&E first learned of the government's investigation when it responded to a request by the Justice Department for information about the bids in question in May of 1995. Since that time, we have been providing information as requested.
"To the extent that there may have been any overcharging by contractors, we will expect appropriate restitution. We will pass any restitution we receive on to our customers in full," it said.
